args.title: Fix handling of quoted CSV header in statement import
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Change parseStatement to split the header line with the same splitFields function used for data lines, so quoted column names on the header line are correctly handled. This allows the statement import to accept headers with double quotes without causing a column count mismatch error.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue was caused by parsing the header line using a simple split on comma, which fails when the header columns are quoted. The file src/ingest/parser.ts is responsible for parsing statement CSVs. The fix is to parse the header line with the same robust splitFields function used for the data rows, which handle quoted fields correctly.
